title: Director, Financial Systems Engineering
description:
About Extend :

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend 's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:
Extend runs a service-contract business where every dollar must be traceable from inbound merchant data, through our operational and analytics databases, into the accounting system, and back out to obligor, reinsurer, and audit reporting. This role owns the systems and controls that keep that traceability automated, tested, and auditable as the business scales.
We are looking for a Director, Financial Systems Engineering to lead that work. The scope includes the invoicing logic, the financial data models the business reports from, and the automated controls that validate results before they reach an invoice. You’ll report into Engineering leadership, and you’ll lead a team of individual contributors.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own SQL and dbt models in version control, review and approve changes to the logic that produces reported numbers, and answer for the correctness of what comes out. You will also own the cross-functional escalation path across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, Revenue/Go-to-Market, and Accounting when commercial commitments and system behavior need to be reconciled.
You will have wide latitude to shape how financial controls and revenue assurance work at a company growing quickly, including how much of that is handled in code.
What You’ll Do:

•
Own the reconciliation system across contracts sold, merchant invoicing, claims paid, and servicing reimbursements. Build automated tie-outs with alerting between inbound merchant data, operational databases, the analytics warehouse, the accounting system, and external reporting, so that variances surface quickly and are routed to an owner.

•
Own the invoicing logic and the programmatic controls that keep contracted commercial terms accurately reflected in it.

•
Own the financial data models the business reports from, including the logic that recognizes contract revenue as contracts mature and the record of what claims cost us. These live in the shared dbt repository and follow its platform standards for tests, PR review, and change control. You own the business logic in these models and review every change to it.

•
Partner with the merchant integration and Data Engineering teams on merchant configuration. They own ingestion and mapping. You facilitate internal audits of how inbound merchant formats map to internal representations, and work with them to resolve what those audits surface, so that expense and contract attribution holds up downstream.

•
Own the exception and reconciliation-break process , covering triage, resolution ownership, and root-cause tracking with SLAs on detection latency, so that findings inform systemic improvements.

•
Partner with Revenue/Go-to-Market on merchant escalations, including direct merchant engagement on billing questions, and coordinate across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, and Accounting on who needs to do what, when, and why

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
tags: R & D : Cloud Service Infra : Platform Infrastructure
description:
About the Role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer on the Compute & Storage Platform team in Toast, you will design, build, and operate the foundational distributed systems powering the Toast platform as the company expands into further international markets and broadens its product offerings to encompass retail shopping.

You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and cutting-edge product development-building low-latency state and storage systems, scalable compute clusters, and high-throughput streaming pipelines. Your work will directly enable Toast product delivery across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).

Key Responsibilities

• Online Databases and Storage: Architect, deploy, and manage low-latency, highly available storage solutions (RDS Postgres and Aurora Postgres; DynamoDB; OpenSearch; S3) to power applications across the Toast product ecosystem.

• High Availability & Realtime Performance: Ensure sub-second end-user latency, near-zero-downtime reliability, and high throughput across storage engines to support Toast's products across POS, phone, computer, drive-thru, and kiosk interfaces.

• Infrastructure for AI-Driven PDLC: Automate infrastructure provisioning and compute pipelines.

• Cost Optimization & Performance Engineering: Right-size compute/storage resources, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage AWS infrastructure costs without compromising platform reliability or latency SLAs.

Required Qualifications

1. Core Infrastructure & Automation

• Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

• Software Development: Fluency in Python , Go , or a similar language for infrastructure automation, tooling, or backend development.

2. Storage & Compute Operations

• Databases: Deep experience operating and tuning enterprise databases at scale. This should include at least one variety of relational database (such as Postgres, Oracle, or MySQL) and at least one type of nonrelational database (such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Opensearch).

• Containerization: Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

3. Systems Reliability & Observability

• Solid understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including monitoring, alerting, health checks, and performance troubleshooting in high-traffic environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

• Observability & Telemetry with Datadog, Prometheus

• AI/ML Infrastructure support

• Cloud Cost Optimization

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s commercial products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend microservices, guest- and restaurant-facing web apps, payment systems, event buses, and more. 

The Infrastructure Engineering group manages Toast's infrastructure via the AWS API, using configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, and internally developed clients using Python and Go. We rely heavily on Datadog and Splunk for monitoring and observability and on FireHydrant for alerting and incident response.

Infrastructure Engineering provides the products and services to support, deploy, and monitor our product suite, which uses a microservice architecture written using JVM and Node.js apps. AWS products are also in heavy usage, ranging from S3 to RDS, DynamoDB, ECS, Lambda, and many others. We have our own platform for user management, service discovery/elevations, and load balancing. We use Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data synchronization between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ and Apache Pulsar clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the applications' RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

title: Software Engineer, OpenAI Presence
description:
About the Team

OpenAI Presence, part of Enterprise Engineering, builds a platform for reliable AI agents that carry out high-volume business workflows. We focus on specific use cases such as customer support, sales, and insurance claims, helping organizations put agents to work in production.

The Presence platform supports the agent development lifecycle, including evaluation, deployment, and improvement through real interactions. It connects agents to company systems and supports voice and chat experiences, with policies, guardrails, and human handoffs to help businesses stay in control. Read the launch announcement https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/.

About the Role

We’re looking for an engineer to help shape the foundations of Presence and build the systems that make AI agents dependable in everyday business operations. You’ll help set the platform’s technical direction while staying close to the code, taking architecture from early decisions through to systems that perform reliably at scale.

You’ll bring deep backend expertise and the product judgment to connect what we build with how businesses use it. The work centers on the services that power Presence and extends across the stack-giving you scope to shape both the underlying systems and the experiences they enable.

In this role, you will:

- Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding architectural decisions and implementation across the Presence platform.

- Design and build backend systems for reliable, high-volume agent workflows in support, sales, and other enterprise use cases.

- Develop platform capabilities that support agent development and learning from real-world use.

- Identify and address reliability bottlenecks as agent workflows become more complex and usage grows.

- Work across backend infrastructure and product experiences as needed, collaborating with other engineers to turn evolving requirements into working software.

Your background might look something like:

- 9+ years of professional engineering experience, excluding internships, in backend, platform, or product engineering roles.

- A track record of hands-on technical leadership, including setting architecture, breaking complex problems into clear implementation plans, and guiding engineers through delivery.

- Deep backend engineering and systems design skills, with proficiency in at least one backend programming language and experience designing services, data models, and interfaces that remain reliable as usage grows.

- End-to-end ownership of complex systems or product capabilities, from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, launch, and production iteration.

- Strong production engineering judgment: you can diagnose difficult failures, reason about performance and scalability, and improve reliability through testing, observability, and operational discipline.

- Strong product judgment that connects technical decisions to user needs, with the ability to balance delivery speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.

- The ability to move between backend infrastructure and product experiences, contribute across the stack when needed, and quickly learn unfamiliar systems, tools, and domains.

- Clear technical communication and effective collaboration across disciplines, including explaining trade-offs, creating alignment, and driving complex work forward while remaining hands-on.

- Experience with AI agents, enterprise workflows, integrations, or agent development and evaluation is a plus, but not required.

Diversity makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
If your experience is close to what we’re looking for, we want to hear from you. Experience comes in many forms - skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way.
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain and enhance our Retool apps and workflow ecosystem by writing JavaScript/TypeScript and SQL to implement new features, optimize existing modules, and refine UI/UX.

• Develop and troubleshoot Slack integrations using JavaScript and Slack’s API to automate messages, alerts, and workflows.

• Participate in architecture discussions, recommend technology improvements, and proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt.

Required Qualifications

• Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and SQL-able to write complex queries, optimize performance, and troubleshoot edge-case failures.

• Hands-on experience with Retool (or similar internal-tools platforms), including custom component development and API integrations.

• Familiarity with Git workflows (feature branching, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD principles.

• Demonstrated knowledge of information-security fundamentals: managing API keys, enforcing the principle of least privilege, and securing data at rest and in transit.

• Track record of maintaining service-level commitments, communicating effectively with non-technical stakeholders, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

• Proven experience building and maintaining Slack bots or integrations via the Slack API.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience; prior roles such as Support Engineer, Technical IT Admin, Customer Service Engineer, or Internal Tools Developer preferred.

Location & Schedule

• Preferred overlap with EST or European business hours to support U.S. and EMEA teams.

As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us on a permanent basis. At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.
Senior Analyst, Credit & Risk
About the Role
World Fuel is seeking a Senior Analyst, Credit & Risk to support credit underwriting, risk management, and working‑capital protection across our North American Land wholesale portfolios. This role plays a key part in evaluating the creditworthiness of new and existing counterparties, analyzing financial risk exposure, and enabling informed commercial decision‑making.
In addition to core underwriting responsibilities, this role supports process and system alignment between PDI and Oracle ERP platforms and provides oversight of an outsourced credit team. The position operates with a high degree of independence while partnering closely with Commercial, Legal, and Finance stakeholders and reports to the Director of NA Land Credit & Risk.
What You’ll Do

• Review and manage inbound credit requests through Kissflow queues to ensure timely and accurate decisions

• Analyze customer financial statements and supporting documentation to recommend credit limits and assess default risk

• Evaluate mark‑to‑market (MTM) exposure and forward trading activity with customers and suppliers

• Determine appropriate credit support and security requirements to mitigate risk

• Partner closely with Commercial and Legal teams to address credit‑related matters for new and existing customers

• Support the establishment and ongoing enforcement of credit policies, underwriting standards, and loss‑control procedures

• Gather, review, and analyze customer information to support credit recommendations

• Assist in standardizing credit reporting, customer credit profiles, and data analysis across platforms

• Contribute to initiatives that improve transparency, reduce handoffs, and enhance the timeliness of bad‑debt reserves and write‑offs

• Support system and process alignment between PDI and Oracle ERP environments following system migrations

• Oversee the daily activities of an outsourced credit team to ensure consistency and accuracy

• Perform ad hoc analysis and special projects as needed

What You Bring

• Strong experience analyzing financial statements and underwriting credit risk

• Working knowledge of forward trading concepts and mark‑to‑market exposure

• Advanced Excel skills with strong attention to detail

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); Power BI is a plus

• Experience with PDI and/or Oracle ERP systems preferred

• Strong analytical, organizational, and time‑management skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively across cross‑functional teams

• Customer‑focused mindset with balanced risk judgment

• Sound business judgment and the ability to make data‑driven credit decisions

• Continuous‑improvement mindset with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required

• 3+ years of experience in credit, risk, or accounting, preferably within commodities, energy, or trading environments

title: Senior Forensics Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Forensics Team

Wayve’s Forensics team sits within the Model Integration and Release group and works at the heart of autonomous-driving performance improvement. We investigate systemic issues across the full end-to-end AV stack-from hardware and software to AI models-and turn our findings into improvements in vehicle safety and performance.

You’ll collaborate across the business with hardware and software engineers, roboticists, model developers, platform teams, operations, and safety specialists. As part of a newly re-formed team, you’ll also help shape our investigative processes, playbooks, and tooling as Wayve’s technology and global fleet continue to grow.⁠

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Lead investigations arising from triage escalations, model alerts, on-road incidents, and ad-hoc requests, driving each problem through to its root cause.

 

- Analyse on-road data, logs, and offline simulations to reproduce issues, identify fleet-wide patterns, and test hypotheses.

 

- Build queries, plots, dashboards, and automated workflows that accelerate investigations and monitor known issues.

 

- Work with the teams that own each system to confirm root causes, validate fixes, and stay engaged through resolution.

 

- Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders through concise written reports, visualisations, and presentations.

 

- Support release testing and the bring-up of new vehicle platforms when investigative or systems-engineering input is needed.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Investigating complex issues across a rapidly growing global vehicle fleet and seeing your findings directly improve AV safety and performance.

 

- Identifying systemic problems spanning the robot, software, and AI models across Wayve’s complete autonomous-driving stack.

 

- Using simulation and offline tools to reproduce and debug issues while minimising the need for fleet resources.

 

- Investigating on-road incidents to establish what happened and why, feeding lessons back into engineering teams and Wayve’s wider safety culture.

 

- Supporting the introduction of new vehicle platforms developed with leading OEMs.

 

- Building the processes, playbooks, training, and automation that will define how this growing team operates.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have at least three years of experience working with complex systems in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or a comparable engineering environment.

 

- You’re a curious, pragmatic systems thinker who enjoys getting hands-on with ambiguous technical problems and following the evidence to a root cause.

 

- You can investigate across a broad technical stack spanning hardware, software, data, and models.

 

- You have experience designing real-world experiments to prove or disprove hypotheses.

 

- You’re confident using Python for data analysis and can write scripts for a range of analytical use cases, using AI tools where appropriate to work more effectively.

 

- You communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

- You collaborate effectively across teams and have used your findings to influence technical decisions or wider organisational direction.

 

- You bring a safety-conscious mindset and are comfortable identifying, escalating, and investigating issues with potential safety implications.

- Experience with machine-learning models, safety-critical systems, autonomous vehicles, robotics, automotive engineering, or fast-moving technology companies would be particularly valuable, but it isn’t essential.⁠

As an ideal candidate, you will have recent exposure to the clinical field and/or experience with the sales of medical devices to deliver clients quality service. Essential Functions

description:
NVIDIA is seeking a technical leader interested in defining, crafting, implementing, and guiding the implementation of security research, architecture, implementation, and design for next-generation NVIDIA Networking products. You'll be expected to take a strong hands-on role, working with diverse teams across NVIDIA and with external partners to meet security requirements for our state-of-the-art network products.
NVIDIA ’s invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing - with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”. We are looking to grow our teams with the smartest people in the world. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
What you'll be doing:

• Research, design, develop and implement architecture solutions (Hardware and software) meeting internal and external security requirements and standards.

• Collaborate across the company to guide the direction of Its (USB, I2C, I3C, UART, PCI) working with hardware, software, research and product teams.

• Architectural modeling, validation, microarchitectural definition, following standards bodies, and developing infrastructure enabling trusted platforms using hardware security methods.

• Work with customers, partners to identify and address security issues and threats.

What we need to see:

• BSc, MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 12+ years of relevant experience.

• First-hand work experience with IO interface including: I2C, I3C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe

• Have directly worked on several of the following:

• Computing platform boot architecture in embedded devices and servers

• RISC-V architecture, Root-of-trust, and security processors.

• Familiarity with embedded systems and programming low-level firmware.

• Familiar with Security-by-design hardware and principles of privileges.

• Programming and debugging fundamentals across languages such as: Verilog, Python/Perl scripting, ARM assembly and C/C++.

• The ability to work in a dynamic collaboration oriented team is required and strong communication skills and a real passion for working as a team are essential.

We run support AI-first: AI tools like Pylon and agents triage tickets, answer them and resolve what they can. You'll have the same technical depth as our Forward Deployed Engineers. You'll dig into the API, SDKs and customers' integrations, reproduce bugs, and open pull requests with fixes for our engineers to review. When a problem truly needs Engineering, you escalate it with everything they need to act, and you stay the customer's point of contact until it's resolved. This is not a script-reading role. You are an engineer who owns the fix.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build the support system: configure our Pylon instance and set up robust ticket tracking, SLA tracking and automations that make the support function as efficient as possible

- Resolve the tickets the AI can't, troubleshooting across the API, SDKs and customer integrations

- Reproduce bugs and fix them, opening pull requests directly for Engineering to review

- Keep the follow-the-sun handoff tight: end each shift with an automated handoff that gives the next Support Engineer full context on open tickets

- Work with the account team (Account Executives, Forward Deployed Engineers), keeping them informed on tickets from their accounts and flagging account-level risk early

- Handle escalation management: watch account health signals, largely through AI, raise every contraction or churn risk to the account team and leadership with requested actions and owners, and follow it until resolved

- Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback and fixes

- Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can read and debug unfamiliar code, and you're comfortable opening pull requests in a production codebase

- A structured approach to ambiguous problems: you ask the right questions, form hypotheses and test them

- Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow

- Availability for shift work as part of a 24/7, follow-the-sun support model

- Have worked as a software engineer, support engineer, solutions engineer or site reliability engineer at a developer-tools, API or AI company

- Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents, and can reason about retrieval and search quality

- Have built automations or AI workflows that took repetitive work off a team

title: Senior Talent Consultant
description:
The Senior Talent Consultant provides strategic talent sourcing solutions to Cielo ’s sourcing teams and hiring teams in client organizations. They collaborate closely with senior leadership and HR teams to understand business objectives and hiring plans, and they design comprehensive talent attraction strategies. Their expertise lies in leveraging industry insights and best practices to create a competitive advantage in acquiring the right talent to support growth and success.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Collaborating with senior leadership and HR teams to understand the client’s workforce needs and developing strategic talent attraction plans aligned with those business objectives.

• Collaborates with recruiters and hiring leaders to oversee recruitment processes, including job profiling, candidate sourcing, assessment, and selection, while ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout.

• Promoting the employer brand to attract top talent, showcasing the organization as an employer of choice on the market.

• Conducting in-depth market research to understand talent trends, industry benchmarks and best practices, providing valuable insight to recruiters, sourcers and hiring teams to improve recruitment strategies.

• Building and maintaining a pipeline of potential candidates for critical and high-demand positions, ensuring a continuous supply of qualified talent.

• Screening candidates via effective interview and selection methods, including competency-based questions and assessment tools.

• Championing diversity and inclusion efforts by promoting inclusive hiring practices and ensuring diverse candidate slates.

• Utilizing data analytics and sourcing metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of talent attraction strategies and make data-driven decisions for process improvement.

• Managing relationships with external recruitment agencies, job boards, and other vendors, as well as liaising with hiring managers and other stakeholders to ensure smooth sourcing operations.

• Ensuring compliance with relevant labour laws, industry regulations and data privacy regulations throughout own and team recruitment processes.

• Representing the client’s organization at networking events, job fairs, and industry conferences to expand the talent network and promote the employer brand.

• Staying updated with emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in talent attraction to continually enhance sourcing solutions.

• Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and supporting the Delivery Lead with daily coaching and direction to the team they are a part of, including leading team huddles to ensure information is shared appropriately.

• Acting as the first line of escalation to ensure appropriate levels of sourcing leadership are informed and involved in the solutioning.

• Assisting the Delivery Lead in onboarding and training new team members.

• Identifying areas for process improvement within the talent sourcing function and suggesting innovative ways to enhance recruitment efficiency.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

- We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

- We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

- We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

- Hybrid - San Francisco, CA

- We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the Role:
As the Partnerships Manager at Sardine, you’ll report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a quota-carrying role that combines growing and activating our signed partners with bringing new partners into the ecosystem. You will own a portfolio of strategic partners and drive revenue through them. Additionally, you will help lead partner recruitment efforts from inception.

You’ll work closely with Sardine and partner-side sales teams to drive revenue, and collaborate with our Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing teams to make sure partners are equipped to succeed. You’ll also help shape our channel strategy and position Sardine as the premier fraud and compliance platform within our partners’ customer bases.

This is a high-impact role that will drive meaningful revenue over time and help make partnerships one of the largest channels for Sardine. You’ll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, Sales leadership, and other members of the leadership team, and play a key role in taking Sardine to the next level.

What You’ll Be Doing:

- Drive revenue: Own a partner portfolio and carry a quota across straight reseller, co-sell, and referral relationships, working with partner and Sardine sales teams to close deals

- Grow across three motions: Partner with Platforms including Payments, Networks, Processors, Banking, AI Ecosystem and other players that embed Sardine, SIs and consultancies that resell, and advisory firms, data partners and VCs who refer prospects

- Enable partners: Enable partner sales and customer support teams to effectively pitch and demo Sardine through training, material creation, and more.

- Generate demand: Collaborate with partners to build and execute joint marketing and BDR campaigns directed at their prospects and clients.

- Recruit and expand: Recruit, onboard, and launch new partners from outreach through first deal, and broaden the scope of signed partners over time

- Plan and optimize: Set targets, build channel strategies, and report on performance, including product gaps and pricing considerations to optimize distribution

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure Sardine is ready on partner platforms, including embedded deployments

What You’ll Need:

- 8+ years of partnership management or years of related experience in B2B software/SaaS,

title: Senior Software Architect, AI Networking
description:
An applied research team within NVIDIA ’s Networking Systems & Software Architecture group is solving some of AI’s hardest infrastructure problems. The team builds systems-level software that moves data between GPUs, nodes, and storage at the speed modern AI demands-spanning low-level transport optimization, hardware-software co-design, and communication frameworks that plug directly into production AI stacks. The team's charter expands into emerging domains including quantum computing interconnects.
The Senior Architect role is to own modules and projects end-to-end-from scoping research questions to shipping production code. It calls for a recognized expert who drives technical decisions, pulls in ideas from research and industry, and regularly prototypes new approaches to prove a point. The work lives at the boundary of applied research and production engineering!
What you will be doing:

• Architecting and implementing high-performance communication and memory management libraries for distributed AI

• Driving hardware-software co-optimization with GPU, DPU, NIC, and switch teams through GPUDirect RDMA, NVLink, and next-generation interconnects

• Profiling and optimizing data movement across GPU memory, system DRAM, NVMe, and network fabrics

• Integrating networking capabilities into AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM

• Contributing to and maintaining open-source projects, mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and prototyping experimental technologies to evaluate their viability

What we need to see:

• 12+ years in systems software and/or networking with demonstrated ownership of complex projects.

• MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Solid understanding of high-performance networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, NVLink, GPUDirect.

• Strong C/C++/Rust systems programming with comfort in performance profiling and low-level debugging.

• Understanding of ML systems concepts-transformer architectures, KV cache mechanics, model parallelism, or distributed training and inference patterns.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge of ML inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and their communication requirements.

• Knowledge of storage networking (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage, S3).

• Background of Reinforcement Learning systems.

With competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely regarded as one of the most desirable technology employers in the world. Our teams are composed of some of the most forward‑thinking and driven engineers in the industry, and we continue to grow rapidly. If you are a senior data engineer passionate about building large‑scale, high‑impact data platforms, we’d love to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 2, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
